NewsArticle.Title: Server Upgrade
NewsArticle.Content: Text Nexon will be installing new hardware at our Internet Service Provider. This upgrade will benefit all of Nexon's games. The upgrade will take place at 1:00 AM PST on Wednesday, September 20th, 2000. We expect service to be unavailable for approximately two hours. ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
